chunks: From him, from Ali ibn al-Abbas al-Muqani'i, from Bakkar ibn Ahmad, from Misbah, from Qays, from Abu Husayn, from Abu Salih, from Abu Huraira, who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: If only one day were to remain from the tenure of the world, Allah would prolong that day until a man from my Ahl al-Bayt emerges, filling the earth with justice, just as it had been filled with oppression and tyranny.
ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the duration of the world and the emergence of Imam Mahdi?
ai.summary: This foundational hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* underscores the eschatological promise of global justice (*‘adl*) through the emergence of a specific leader from the Ahl al-Bayt, a core tenet of Twelver Shia theology. It highlights the divine agency in extending time (*tawil*) to ensure the completion of this mission, linking the Mahdi’s appearance directly to the rectification of worldly oppression. The narration serves as a key proof for the inevitability of the Mahdi’s rule and its universal scope.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 139 - It is narrated from Ali bin Abbas Maqanai Bakkar bin Ahmad from Misbah from Qays from Abu Husain from Abu Salih from Abu Huraira that he said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) said: If a single day remains from the tenure of the world, Allah, the Mighty and the High would prolong that day to such an extent that a man from my progeny will appear; he would fill the earth with justice and equity, just as it would have been fraught with injustice and oppression.
